Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my knee, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. We'll keep it brief. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was on a two-lane road in Conroe, Texas, near a shopping center entrance.
Q: What time of day was it, roughly?
A: Mid-afternoon, maybe around three. It was daylight and the road was dry.
Q: Walk me through what happened.
A: I was heading east and slowing for traffic. The other car came over into my lane, and we ended up nose to nose. It
wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me.
Q: How fast do you think you were going?
A: Probably under fifteen miles an hour. I had just started to brake.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. I hit my right knee on the lower part of the dashboard.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I did, but my knee was throbbing and I had trouble putting weight on it. Someone at the scene called for help.
Q: Did you seek medical care?
A: Yes, I was taekn to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me there was swelling and
possibly a ligament strain.
Q: Have you been seeing a doctor since then?
A: I've had two follow-up visits with my primary physician, and I'm doing physical therapy twice a week now.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm trying to get back to work, and the knee still makes stairs difficult.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>
